HOLLOWKNIGHT-OLD_NAIL.title: Old Nail
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHELL.title: Shell
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FOCUS.title: Focus
HOLLOWKNIGHT-QUICK_SLASH.title: Quick Slash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-VENGEFUL_SPIRIT.title: Vengeful Spirit
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DASH.title: Dash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DARK_SHRINE.title: Dark Shrine
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DARK_SHRINE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and {SoulGain:diff()} SOUL. Your next Attack Spell this turn deals +{Blessing:diff()} damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-ABYSS_SHRIEK.title: Abyss Shriek
HOLLOWKNIGHT-ABYSS_SHRIEK.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies; +5 damage for each other surviving enemy.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-UNBREAKABLE_STRENGTH.title: Unbreakable Strength
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GREAT_SLASH.title: Great Slash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CYCLONE_SLASH.title: Cyclone Slash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CYCLONE_SLASH.description: Nail Art. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DASH_SLASH.title: Dash Slash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DESOLATE_DIVE.title: Desolate Dive
HOLLOWKNIGHT-STEADY_BODY.title: Steady Body
HOLLOWKNIGHT-STEADY_BODY.description: At the end of your turn, gain {SteadyBody:diff()} Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-THORNS_OF_AGONY.title: Thorns of Agony
HOLLOWKNIGHT-THORNS_OF_AGONY.description: When you are attacked, deal {ThornsOfAgony:diff()} damage back to the attacker.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHAMAN_STONE.title: Shaman Stone
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CHANNELLED_NAIL.title: Channelled Nail
HOLLOWKNIGHT-COILED_NAIL.title: Coiled Nail
HOLLOWKNIGHT-COILED_NAIL.description: Your Nail attacks strike 1 additional time. This effect does not stack.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-KINGSOUL.title: Kingsoul
HOLLOWKNIGHT-KINGSOUL.description: For every 33 SOUL you hold, Nail attacks deal {Kingsoul:diff()} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BALDUR_SHELL.title: Baldur Shell
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BALDUR_SHELL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. This turn, whenever an enemy attacks you, deal {BaldurShell:diff()} damage back.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHAPE_OF_UNN.title: Shape of Unn
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOWLING_WRAITHS.title: Howling Wraiths
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOWLING_WRAITHS.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies 3 times.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHADE_SOUL.title: Shade Soul
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHADE_SOUL.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply 2 Vulnerable. Deal 12 damage to all OTHER enemies.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DESCENDING_DARK.title: Descending Dark
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DESCENDING_DARK.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and 6 damage that ignores Block. Gain {Block:diff()} Block next turn.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHADE_CLOAK.title: Shade Cloak
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHADE_CLOAK.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Until your next turn, prevent HP loss from the next enemy attack that is not fully blocked.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAM_NAIL.title: Dream Nail
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAM_NAIL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and draw 1 card. Against ELITE or BOSS enemies, draw {Dreams:diff()} cards instead.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEEP_FOCUS.title: Deep Focus
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DEEP_FOCUS.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Heal {Heal:diff()} HP and draw 1 card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TOTEM.title: Soul Totem
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TOTEM.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Gain {Energy:diff()} Energy and draw {Draw:diff()} card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVERSONG.title: Weaversong
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVERSONG.description: Summon a Weaverling with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. At the start of each turn, add a Weaver Bite to your hand. Your Weaver Bites deal {Weaversong:diff()} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVER_BITE.title: Weaver's Bite
HOLLOWKNIGHT-LIFEBLOOD_COCOON.title: Lifeblood Cocoon
HOLLOWKNIGHT-LIFEBLOOD_COCOON.descriptio: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. This turn, gain {SoulPerAbsorb:diff()} [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img] whenever your Block absorbs damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FURY_OF_THE_FALLEN.title: Fury of the Fallen
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WHETSTONE.title: Whetstone
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WHETSTONE.description: Gain {Whetstone:diff()} Whetstone. This turn, your Nail attacks deal additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-STALWART_SHELL.title: Stalwart Shell
HOLLOWKNIGHT-STALWART_SHELL.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If your HP is 50% or less, gain it again.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PRIDES_MARK.title: Pride's Mark
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PRIDES_MARK.description: Skill charge pays out double. Whenever you play a Sword Art, draw {PridesMark:diff()} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PRIDES_MARK.flavor: Everything the eye can see is hunting ground.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CHARGED_ARTS.title: Charged Arts
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CHARGED_ARTS.description: Each Skill you play this turn adds +{ChargedArts:diff()} damage to your next Sword Art (stacks; consumed when a Sword Art is played).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CHARGED_ARTS.flavor: Charge held for one perfect slash.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_UNBOUND.title: Soul Unbound
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_UNBOUND.description: Requires 33 SOUL. Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage ({CalculationBase:diff()} base, plus {ExtraDamage:diff()} per 33 SOUL held), then lose all SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_UNBOUND.flavor: Overflowing soul cuts deeper than any nail.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TYRANT.title: Soul Tyrant
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TYRANT.description: Whenever one of your Spells kills an enemy, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card (max 2 triggers per turn). This effect does not stack.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TYRANT.flavor: A throne built from the souls of others.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CAREFREE_MELODY.title: Carefree Melody
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CAREFREE_MELODY.description: Gain {CarefreeMelody:diff()} Lullaby. When you take fatal damage, consume a Lullaby: survive at 1 HP and gain 22 Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CAREFREE_MELODY.flavor: The departed soul still hums for its bearer.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONGS_MELODY.title: Grubsong's Melody
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONGS_MELODY.descriptio: Whenever you actually lose HP, gain {GrubsongsMelody:diff()} SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBSONGS_MELODY.flavor: The grub's song brews pain into power.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARP_ASSAULT.title: Sharp Assault
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARP_ASSAULT.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage and draw 1 card. After 4 hits on enemies this turn, damage increases by {ExtraDamage:diff()} (included above).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SHARP_ASSAULT.flavor: After the combo, a sharpened finisher.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CAREFREE_MELODY_POWER.descr: When you take fatal damage, consume a layer: survive at 1 HP and gain 22 Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-CAREFREE_MELODY_POWER.smart: When you take fatal damage, consume a layer: survive at 1 HP and gain 22 Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-KINGSOUL.flavor: A pale charm of the King's own essence.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-KINGSOUL_POWER.description: For every 33 SOUL you hold, Nail attacks deal {Amount} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-KINGSOUL_POWER.smartDescrip: For every 33 SOUL you hold, Nail attacks deal {Amount} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PRIDES_MARK_POWER.title: Pride's Mark
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PRIDES_MARK_POWER.descripti: Skill charge pays out double. Whenever you play a Sword Art, draw {Amount} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PRIDES_MARK_POWER.smartDesc: Skill charge pays out double. Whenever you play a Sword Art, draw {Amount} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPELLCHARGE.title: Spellcharge
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPELLCHARGE.description: Each Skill you play this turn adds +{Spellcharge:diff()} damage to your next Attack Spell (stacks; consumed when an Attack Spell is played).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SPELLCHARGE.flavor: Whispers gather into echoes; echoes brew into storms.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOULBELL.title: Soulbell
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOULBELL.description: The first Spell you play each turn draws {Soulbell:diff()} additional card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOULBELL.flavor: Where the toll rings, dreams wake.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FULL_SOUL.title: Full Soul
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FULL_SOUL.description: If you had at least 66 SOUL before playing a Spell, it deals {FullSoul:diff()} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FULL_SOUL.flavor: A brimming vessel makes even echoes shine.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROKEN_SHELL.title: Broken Shell
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROKEN_SHELL.description: Whenever one of your cards is Exhausted, gain {BrokenShell:diff()} Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROKEN_SHELL.flavor: The sound of cracking is the sound of building.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROKEN_VESSEL.title: Broken Vessel
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROKEN_VESSEL.flavor: The cracked shell hides the sharpest edge.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TORRENT.title: Soul Torrent
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TORRENT.description: Consume 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times (X = energy spent).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_TORRENT.flavor: The deep well overturns; soul floods like tide.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAMSHIELD.title: Dreamshield
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAMSHIELD.description: At the start of each of the next 3 turns, gain {Dreamshield:diff()} Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-DREAMSHIELD.flavor: A woven dream, softer than any shell.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_SURGE.title: Soul Surge
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_SURGE.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and draw 1 card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_SURGE.flavor: The tide of souls surges onward.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRIMMCHILD.title: Grimmchild
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRIMMCHILD.description: Summon Grimmchild with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. Its end-of-turn flame deals {Grimmchild:diff()} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRIMMCHILD.flavor: An ember of nightmare, growling within the shell.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HEAVY_BLOW.title: Heavy Blow
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HEAVY_BLOW.flavor: A crushing blow that shatters shells.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-MOTHWING_DASH.title: Mothwing Dash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-MOTHWING_DASH.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Draw {Cards:diff()} card. If you have at least {SoulThreshold} SOUL when played, draw {BonusCards} additional card.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-MOTHWING_DASH.flavor: One beat of moth's wings, a shade in tow.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBBERFLY_ELEGANCE.title: Grubberfly's Elegance
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBBERFLY_ELEGANCE.descrip: While at FULL HP, your Nail attacks deal {GrubberflyElegance:diff()} additional damage.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRUBBERFLY_ELEGANCE.flavor: An unblemished vessel shines with grace.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FLUKENEST.title: Flukenest
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FLUKENEST.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy 3 times.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-FLUKENEST.flavor: The nest breaks open; flukes scatter.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PAIN_BRAND.title: Pain Brand
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PAIN_BRAND.description: Whenever you take unblocked damage, gain {PainBrand:diff()} Strength.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-PAIN_BRAND.flavor: Wounds are the whetstone of the nail.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SECOND_WIND.title: Second Wind
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SECOND_WIND.description: Exhaust all non-Attack cards in your hand. Gain {Block:diff()} Block for each.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SECOND_WIND.flavor: One breath out, one breath in — every breath a wall.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_FLOW.title: Soul Flow
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_FLOW.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Gain 1 Energy and draw {Draw:diff()} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_FLOW.flavor: SOUL runs through the veins like strength.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEB_SPIN.title: Web Spin
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEB_SPIN.flavor: Where the thread reaches, a cocoon forms.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-RICOCHET_NAIL.title: Ricochet Nail
HOLLOWKNIGHT-RICOCHET_NAIL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy 2 times.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_HARVEST.title: Soul Harvest
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_HARVEST.description: Spend 33 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Heal 5 HP for each enemy killed.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_STORM.title: Nail Storm
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_STORM.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times (X = energy spent).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-NAIL_STORM.flavor: Nail-shadows sweep Hallownest like a storm.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_AEGIS.title: Soul Aegis
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_AEGIS.description: Gain 1 Block for every 2 SOUL held (rounded down), then lose all SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_AEGIS.flavor: A brimming vessel makes the final wall.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_PACT.title: Soul Pact
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_PACT.description: Exhaust 1 card from your hand. Draw {Draw:diff()} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_PACT.flavor: Give one, gain two — a fair contract.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_ECHO.title: Soul Echo
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_ECHO.description: Whenever you play a card that actually spends SOUL, draw {SoulEcho:diff()} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_ECHO.flavor: What you give comes echoing back.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_BATTERY.title: Soul Battery
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_BATTERY.description: At the start of each of your turns, gain {SoulBattery:diff()} SOUL.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_BATTERY.flavor: Still water rises on its own.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_SIPHON.title: Soul Siphon
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_SIPHON.flavor: Their essence flows back along the nail.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-TWIN_SLASH.title: Twin Slash
HOLLOWKNIGHT-TWIN_SLASH.flavor: Two cuts in one breath, SOUL in every step.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-RESIDUAL_SOUL.title: Residual Soul
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVER_NEST.title: Weaver Nest
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVER_NEST.description: Summon a Weaverling with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. It deals 3 damage to a random enemy at the end of your turn.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRIMM_RITE.title: Grimm Rite
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GRIMM_RITE.description: Spend 22 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Summon Grimmchild with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. Repeated summons mature its end-of-turn flame (5→8→11), not its commands.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GLOWING_WOMB.title: Glowing Womb
HOLLOWKNIGHT-GLOWING_WOMB.description: Spend 8 [img]res://HollowKnight/images/charui/soul_icon_text.png[/img]. Summon a Hatchling with {SummonHp:diff()} HP. When it dies, it explodes for 9 damage to a random enemy.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_RUSH.title: Swarm Rush
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_RUSH.description: Command each living companion to deal {CommandDamage:diff()} damage to the target.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-TEND_BROOD.title: Tend the Brood
HOLLOWKNIGHT-TEND_BROOD.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Summon a Weaverling with {SummonHp:diff()} HP.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_CHORUS.title: Brood Chorus
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_CHORUS.description: Summon a Weaverling, Grimmchild and a Hatchling, each with {SummonHp:diff()} HP.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVER_VOLLEY.title: Weaver Volley
HOLLOWKNIGHT-WEAVER_VOLLEY.description: Command your Weaverling to deal {CommandDamage:diff()} damage 3 times. Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_ASSAULT.title: Brood Assault
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_ASSAULT.description: Command your healthiest companion to deal {BaseDamage:diff()} damage plus its current HP.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HATCHLING_BURST.title: Hatchling Burst
HOLLOWKNIGHT-HATCHLING_BURST.description: Command your Hatchling to deal {BaseDamage:diff()} damage plus its current HP to ALL enemies, then sacrifice it. Its death explosion still triggers.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SILKEN_AEGIS.title: Silken Aegis
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SILKEN_AEGIS.description: Sacrifice your healthiest companion. Gain Block equal to {Multiplier:diff()} times its current HP, up to {MaxBlock:diff()} base Block.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_OFFERING.title: Brood Offering
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_OFFERING.description: Sacrifice your least healthy companion. Gain 1 Energy and {SoulGain:diff()} SOUL. Draw {Draw:diff()} card(s).
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_ECHO.title: Swarm Echo
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SWARM_ECHO.description: Command your healthiest companion to deal {CommandDamage:diff()} damage. Repeat once for each earlier companion command strike this turn, up to 4 total strikes.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_INSTINCT.title: Brood Instinct
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_INSTINCT.description: Companions deal {Bonus:diff()} additional damage. Draw 1 card on your first companion summon each turn.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_NOURISHMENT.title: Soul Nourishment
HOLLOWKNIGHT-SOUL_NOURISHMENT.descriptio: The first 3 damaging Weaverling command hits each turn gain 3 SOUL each. For every 33 SOUL spent on cards, living companions gain {Growth:diff()} current and maximum HP.
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_RETURN.title: Brood Return
HOLLOWKNIGHT-BROOD_RETURN.description: Resummon your most recently fallen companion with {SummonHp:diff()} HP, if it has not already been resummoned.
